rows.title: Thread notifications
rows.description: System alerts when a thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval. Applies to this device while T3 Code is open.

rows.title: In-app notifications
rows.description: Show a toast when another thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval while this app has focus.

rows.title: Project grouping
rows.description: Combine matching repositories across environments.

rows.title: Project order
rows.description: Order of projects in the sidebar project picker and command palette.

rows.title: Working section
rows.description: Fold working and monitoring threads into a Working section. They return to the top of the inbox when they need you. The boring sidebar in Labs has no Working section.

rows.title: Unpin confirmation
rows.description: Ask before unpinning a thread from the pinned section.

rows.title: Archive confirmation
rows.description: Require a second click on the inline archive action before a thread is archived.

rows.title: Delete confirmation
rows.description: Ask before deleting a thread and its chat history.

rows.title: Quit shortcut
rows.description: Hold mode also quits on two quick presses.

rows.title: Time format
rows.description: System default follows your browser or OS clock preference.

rows.title: Rich text composer
rows.description: Show formatted Markdown as you type.

rows.title: Send shortcut
rows.description: Choose when Enter sends a prompt or inserts a new line

rows.title: Show skills in slash menu
rows.description: Also include skills in the / command menu. Skills always appear when you type $.

rows.title: Follow-up behavior
rows.description: Queue follow-ups while the agent runs or steer the current run.

rows.title: Diff layout
rows.description: Show diffs stacked or side by side. The toggle in the diff toolbar changes this too.

rows.title: Hide whitespace changes
rows.description: Set whether the diff panel ignores whitespace-only edits by default.

rows.title: Default diff file state
rows.description: Start with files expanded or collapsed when opening diffs or a pull request's Code tab.

rows.title: Diff colors
rows.description: Choose colors for additions and deletions, including change counts.

rows.title: Open pull requests and changes panels proactively
rows.description: Open linked pull requests first. Otherwise, open Changes for edits to at least 3 files or 50 lines.

rows.title: Open pull requests in T3 Code
rows.description: Clicking a pull request link opens it in T3 Code. Turn off to open pull request links like any other link, on your git host.

rows.title: Contrast
rows.description: Adjust the contrast of colors and borders across the interface.

rows.title: Glass opacity
rows.description: Higher values make menus, dialogs, and the composer more solid.

rows.title: Chat width
rows.description: Set how wide messages and the composer can grow on large screens.

rows.title: Effort display
rows.description: Show reasoning effort in the composer as its name, such as High, or as bars.

rows.title: Render math
rows.description: Typeset LaTeX math, such as $x^2$ or \[x^2\], in messages and Markdown previews. The composer keeps TeX source editable.

rows.title: Panel animations
rows.description: Set how fast panels open and close.

rows.title: Composer context
rows.description: Keep branch and worktree controls below the composer after a thread starts.

rows.title: Font smoothing
rows.description: Use thinner grayscale text smoothing instead of the macOS default.

rows.title: Agent browser access
rows.description: Allow agents to use the shared browser. Projects can override it.

rows.title: Open links in
rows.description: Where links in the chat and terminal open. Hold ⌘ or Ctrl while clicking a link to open it in your default browser either way.

rows.title: Auto-show floating preview
rows.description: Show the floating preview when an agent opens a browser or device unless the agent says otherwise.

rows.title: Search engine
rows.description: What the address bar searches when you type something that isn't a URL.

rows.title: Default browser viewport
rows.description: Tab size for you and agents. Fill fits the panel; other sizes show the device toolbar.

rows.title: Default browser zoom
rows.description: Page zoom applied to new browser tabs.

rows.title: Default browser appearance
rows.description: The color scheme pages are told to prefer. System follows your OS setting.

rows.title: Browser recording frame rate
rows.description: Maximum recording rate. 30 fps saves CPU and storage; 60 fps is smoother.

rows.title: Show key presses in recordings
rows.description: Show pressed keys and shortcuts in new recordings. Password fields are excluded.

rows.title: Show mouse presses in recordings
rows.description: Highlight mouse presses and held buttons in new recordings.

rows.title: Boring sidebar (group by project)
rows.description: Group sidebar threads into project folders. Pinned threads stay on top, and Snoozed and Settled stay below the folders.

rows.title: Two-line folder rows
rows.description: In the boring sidebar, show folder threads on two lines: the title, then the branch, pull request, and agent.

rows.title: Guest links
rows.description: Share a thread with a guest who watches it live in their browser and sends messages you approve. Needs T3 Connect: sign in and link this machine in [Sharing & access](/settings/access). While it is off, every guest link stops working.

rows.title: Linked environments
rows.description: Let agents here work on your other machines, and theirs here. Turn it on for each machine, then link them in [Connections](/settings/connections). While it is off, nothing new starts over a link; tasks already running finish.

rows.title: Simlock device hosts (alpha)
rows.description: Let the Device panel lease simulators and emulators from your own [Simlock](https://incubator.callstack.com/simlock/) pool, added in [Devices](/settings/devices). An alpha that may change or break. T3 Code never installs Simlock.

rows.title: Plan mode (legacy)
rows.description: Restore Build/Plan, /plan, /default, and Shift+Tab. Off uses build mode.

rows.title: Context window indicator (legacy)
rows.description: Shows context window usage as a circular indicator in the composer.

rows.title: Worktree location
rows.description: Folder where new worktrees are created, on any drive, such as D:\\worktrees or ~/worktrees. Existing worktrees stay where they are. Leave empty to use the T3 home folder.

rows.title: Start from remote
rows.description: Uses the latest commit of the base branch’s tracked remote branch, even if its name differs. Otherwise uses the same-named branch on origin. Uses your local branch if that remote branch is missing.

rows.title: Branch prefix
rows.description: For example, t3 or t3/ produces t3/add-search. Leave empty for no prefix.

rows.title: Provider update checks
rows.description: Check installed provider CLIs for newer available versions and fetch model catalog updates. When off, new models may not appear.

rows.title: Continue threads after restarts
rows.description: Automatically resume interrupted threads after an update, crash, or machine restart on the selected environments.

rows.title: Add project starts in
rows.description: Leave empty to use "~/" when the Add Project browser opens.

rows.title: Permissions
rows.description: Default permissions for new threads. Projects can override them.

rows.title: Workspace
rows.description: Where new threads start. Projects and their t3.json can override it.

rows.title: Resume after usage limits
rows.description: Automatically resume threads when their usage limits reset. You can cancel auto-resume in each thread.

rows.title: Snooze until limits reset
rows.description: Snooze threads until their usage limits reset. Enable auto-resume to continue the agent after the reset.

rows.title: Auto-settle merged threads
rows.description: Settle a thread when its pull request merges. Closed pull requests still settle automatically.

rows.title: Days of inactivity before auto-settle
rows.description: Any new activity un-settles a thread automatically.

rows.title: Keep threads with a PR
rows.description: Inactivity does not settle threads with a pull request. Merge and close still do.

rows.title: Thread title instructions
rows.description: Appended to the prompt for new and regenerated thread titles.

rows.title: Worktree location
rows.description: Folder where new worktrees are created, on any drive, such as D:\\worktrees or ~/worktrees. Existing worktrees stay where they are. Leave empty to use the T3 home folder.
